Opener beginning a little choppy as I was still on my way to my seat when the lights went off and didn't plug in the mics til after the first song.

Another secondary market crash I had my eye on for weeks, though a freebie came through last minute, maybe 9,000 ish in attendance but they just played Anaheim a few months ago. Also there are just so many events this summer, to the point where I think Taylor Swift and the mega-events as well as the rise of incidental costs such as parking is also driving out the middle class in touring acts as well as similar acts often playing the same night cannibalizing sales.

Teddy Swims covered Don't Stop Believin' on the 40th anniversary of night 5 of 5 Journey shows with Bryan Adams opening. One of those was my first ever show! Great to celebrate first concert anniversary week twice at the Forum! My favorite place to smoke weed, exercise and nap in public as well as see some bands from to time.

Greta Van Fleet was a stark reminder one of the great tragedies and losses of the lockdown era was not getting to see Krokus. Otherwise pretty fun show, especially the jammy parts where the singer was off stage. Wouldn't have minded if he walked off and just didn't come back.
